segments.name: Traditional banking
segments.description: Provides traditional banking services, including loans and deposit accounts, to customers in southern Louisiana.
segments.evidence: The Company's revenue, from continuing operations, is primarily derived from the business of traditional banking.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest and fees on loans, and customers pay fees for deposit and other banking services.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues from traditional banking operations consist primarily of interest and fees earned on loans held for investment, interest earned on securities, and fees from deposit and other banking services.

changes.text: In 2025 the mortgage banking segment, NOLA Lending Group, was agreed for sale, closed in 2026, and is no longer reported as a segment.
changes.evidence: As a result, the mortgage banking operations are presented as discontinued operations for all periods presented, and the Company no longer reports mortgage banking as a separate operating or reportable segment.
